headline: Cardiff family picks
summary: Dated picks are empty until the morning automation writes today's shortlist. Evergreen venues below stay available with official links.

evergreen.title: National Museum Cardiff
evergreen.description: Art, natural history and science galleries in the city centre. Under-16s must visit with an adult.

evergreen.title: St Fagans National Museum of History
evergreen.description: Historic buildings, open meadows and indoor galleries. A dependable all-weather family day out west of the city.

evergreen.title: Techniquest
evergreen.description: Hands-on science centre in Cardiff Bay. Capacity can be limited — confirm times and tickets on the venue site.

evergreen.title: Bute Park
evergreen.description: Central parkland beside Cardiff Castle — paths, play space and room to roam without booking.
